dedupe_keys.name: mapa das redes do sistema geodesico brasileiro

description: MAPA DAS REDES DO SISTEMA GEODÉSICO BRASILEIRO is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Mapa das Redes do Sistema Geodésico Brasileiro (SGB), versão 2020, na escala 1:5 000 000 (1cm = 50km) é uma representação cartográfica mural que traz informações sobre as redes planialtimétrica, altimétrica e gravimétrica, bem como das redes ativas: Rede Maregráfica Permanente para Geodésia (RMPG) e Rede Brasileira de Monitoramento Contínuo dos Sistemas GNSS (RBMC). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Mapa das Redes do Sistema Geodésico Brasileiro, Brasil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
